decisions.reason: The free tier is limited to 100 one-time credits with no recurring free plan, so any sustained use requires moving to the $5/mo paid plan, making paid_plan the real blocker rather than none.

decisions.reason: A developer can self-serve a key and build immediately, but the free allowance is only 100 trial credits and continued/production use requires a paid plan, which is a caveat rather than fully free/ready.
